structure: Capability coverage. Structured twin of research/THREAT_COVERAGE_MATRIX.md — update both together.

Architecture decisions (ADRs)
Threat coverage matrix
Authentication (JWT + PBKDF2) and RBAC
SQLite database with WAL
Asset inventory (manual + auto-registration from telemetry)
Authenticated event ingestion gateway
OCSF-aligned event normalization
Deterministic detection rule engine
Alert management with analyst workflow
Incident correlation (entity grouping + attack-chain escalation)
WebSocket live streaming
Hash-chained audit log
System health registry
Network detection set: beaconing, C2/DGA, DNS tunneling, exfiltration volume, port scan
Network Security UI page (telemetry + network rule alerts)
Endpoint detection set: PowerShell abuse, persistence, credential dump, Run keys, service creation, ransomware velocity
Endpoint Security UI page (process/file/auth telemetry + host rule alerts)
Impossible-travel identity detection (geo-annotated auth telemetry)
Web/API attack patterns: SQLi, XSS, SSRF, path traversal
Malware static analysis: hashing, entropy, PE parse, strings, zip/archive, Office macro detection
File analysis API + Multimodal Forensics UI (hash lookup, no byte retention)
Threat intelligence engine: STIX 2.1 import, dedup, indicator aging, event enrichment, INTEL-IOC-001 alerts

Zeek/Suricata/Sysmon/osquery/Wazuh log-tail adapters
YARA scanning + isolated sandbox adapter
MISP/OpenCTI live TAXII feed clients (Phase 2 uses local STIX feeds)

QR code security (OpenCV decode + payload threat analysis)
Image forensics (metadata/EXIF, generative-AI tool strings, recompression probe)
Audio forensics — WAV/PCM statistics with low-confidence synthetic-speech indicators
Video forensics — OpenCV-decodable containers, frame/face statistics (no neural detectors)
PDF/OOXML document structural analysis (script/action object indicators)
OCR text extraction (no tesseract binary in this build)
Neural deepfake/synthetic-speech detectors (needs ML runtime + models)
MP3/OGG/FLAC audio decoding (needs bundled decoders)
Agent security monitoring (built with the Phase-4 agent layer)
Agent orchestrator and specialist agents (deterministic, read-only, no LLM required)
Permission boundaries: read-only specialists, per-investigation evidence chain (SHA-256), time budget
Evidence collection with chain of custody (per-step hashes, tamper-evident chain)
Threat hunting queries and long-term timelines (/hunt API + UI)
LLM-narrated investigation summaries (optional post-hook, no model in this build)
Policy-authorized response engine (allowlist actions, L0/L1/L2 autonomy levels)
Approval workflows, dry-run, rollback and post-action verification
Isolated deception and honeypot subsystem with containment boundaries (loopback bind, safe stop)
Enterprise workflow integrations (ticketing, chatops) — none available in this build
Interactive 3D operations environment (R3F, WebGL + 2D fallback): partitioned rooms with doors/glass, desks with monitors, wall signage, central video wall, ceiling beams
Digital twin: room metrics from real REST, markers from confirmed WS frames (no simulated activity)
Incident historical replay (real persisted alerts, pause/resume)
Live agent avatars and attack-path animation (declined by design: would fabricate activity — real WS markers shown instead)
Multi-factor authentication (TOTP RFC 6238 + single-use recovery codes, stdlib-only)
Local installer + first-run configuration (scripts/install.ps1, backend/.env)
Database backup tool (consistent SQLite online backup, rolling retention)
SBOM generation (CycloneDX 1.5 from installed package metadata)
Performance smoke tests (regression guards, not benchmarks)
Automated update mechanism / package distribution (installer app, no GUI packaging)
Enterprise workflow integrations (SSO/SAML/LDAP, ticketing)
